summary.text: Pam Altendorf is a Republican member of the Minnesota House of Representatives from District 20A, with a tenure beginning in 2023, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Altendorf lives in Red Wing and has worked as a senior vice president of sales and management.

paragraphs.text: Pam Altendorf lives in Red Wing, Minnesota.
Her career experience includes working as a senior vice president of sales and management.
Altendorf succeeded Brian Pfarr in District 20A and took office on January 3, 2023.
